FX-IRIS-028.says: Iris Points 6, completion 50: a triangle standing on its base, its top point straight up from the middle, closing on (8, 5); inside it is kept and outside it gone.

FX-IRIS-029.says: Iris Points 8, completion 50: a diamond, four corners up, right, down and left, closing on the middle.

FX-IRIS-030.says: Iris Points 8, Outer Radius 4.3: After Effects' hole, a diamond reaching 4.3 pixels up, down, left and right from the middle, transparent; every pixel outside it is kept exactly. Completion is not read.

FX-IRIS-031.says: Iris Points 10, Outer Radius 4.6, Use Inner Radius on, Inner Radius 2.1: a five-pointed star hole, its top point straight up.

FX-IRIS-032.says: FX-IRIS-030 turned 45 degrees: the diamond becomes a square standing level, its corners 4.3 from the middle.

FX-IRIS-033.says: FX-IRIS-030 with feather 2: the hole's edge soft over 2 units of the shape's own size, each pixel faded as a whole.

FX-IRIS-034.says: FX-IRIS-030 with invert on: only the diamond is kept, everything outside it gone, so the two add up to the drawing.

FX-IRIS-035.says: Iris Points 0, the circle, Outer Radius 4.3: a round hole of radius 4.3.

FX-IRIS-036.says: Iris Points 8, Outer Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8.6 at frame 4, linear, as the tutorial keys it: frame 0 is the drawing (Outer Radius 0 reads Completion, 0), frame 2 is FX-IRIS-030, and frame 4 a hole twice as big.

FX-IRIS-037.says: Iris Points 4, below 6: the circle, FX-IRIS-003 exactly.

FX-IRIS-038.says: Iris Points 6, completion 50, Use Inner Radius on with Inner Radius 1: with Outer Radius 0 the inner radius is not read, so FX-IRIS-028 exactly.

FX-IRIS-039.says: FX-IRIS-029 moved three pixels right: the same, moved, and the three columns left of the drawing stay empty.

FX-IRIS-040.says: Iris Points 33, above 32. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IRIS-041.says: Iris Points -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IRIS-042.says: Outer Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IRIS-043.says: Inner Radius 100001, above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IRIS-044.says: Use Inner Radius "yes", not "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IRIS-045.says: Rotation 100001, past the most. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
